Licenses

Third-party notices: public skills

The lab package redistributes ten skill folders from five public repositories. They are authentic upstream files, not rewritten or renamed lab skills. Each folder is copied complete, byte for byte, from the pinned commit below.

The six additional software-development skills under engineering-skills/ are original Lab 2 materials, not third-party imports. Their names and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in engineering-skills/skills-manifest.json.

Where the licenses are

  • MIT licenses: vendor/skill-pack/skill-licenses/<source>-LICENSE in the complete lab, and .github/skill-licenses/ in the skills-only ZIP and the generated learner workspace.
  • Apache-2.0 for frontend-design: skills/frontend-design/LICENSE.txt, shipped inside the skill folder exactly as upstream distributes it.

Integrity

vendor/skill-pack/skills-manifest.json records each source repository, commit, license and upstream path, plus SHA-256 hashes of all 29 redistributed files. Learner copies keep it as .github/skills-manifest.json, and npm run skills and npm run check fail if any file is missing, extra or changed.

The six lab-authored skill files are checked against the separate engineering-skills/skills-manifest.json when the pack is installed and verified. Installed copies keep it as .github/engineering-skills-manifest.json, and the skills ZIP includes it beside the upstream manifest.

Scope

The portable installation does not install plugin hooks or bootstrap infrastructure. Some upstream skill folders include helper scripts as reference material; the lab does not execute them. grill-me is a thin entry point that hands over to grilling, so both are shipped together.

Files were fetched from each commit's Git tree and raw file URLs on 2026-11-02. Popularity on skills.sh or GitHub is a point-in-time signal, not a safety or quality guarantee.

Preserve the supplied licenses and copyright notices when copying or redistributing these files.
